messages:
Asha Kapoor: quick report from onboarding: customer rotated project token, deployed, then started seeing 401s. CLI logs said it used ~/.redwood/config token even though REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY was exported.
Ben Wu: that's bad. does the CLI cache config at startup?
Asha Kapoor: yes looks like a singleton read that the deploy path used. steps: export REDWOOD_API_KEY=org-legacy; export REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY=proj-old; run rw dev; rotate token -> export REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY=proj-new; rw deploy -> deploy log: 'Using credentials from ~/.redwood/config' -> later 401s.
Carlos Mendes: two problems: env alias confusion and precedence bug. Proposed canonicalization: prefer REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY, accept REDWOOD_API_KEY as legacy alias, deprecate REDWOOD_ORG_KEY in samples. Put the same precedence in CLI and SDKs: 1) --key flag 2) REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY 3) project key in ~/.redwood/config 4) REDWOOD_API_KEY.
Yvonne Park: SDKs also masking the issue by retrying on 401. JS client retries once by default; that just amplifies rate limits. We should not retry on 401/403, surface TokenScopeError with a hint: 'token lacks project scope; try REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY or create a project token.'
Ben Wu: small UX improvement: when env value differs from config store, print a one-line banner: 'Detected REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY changed; using env value' and optionally write a volatile state file for tests. Add --show-cred-source debug flag to CLI.
Asha Kapoor: sample apps bake env into images frequently. suggest adding a README section 'rotating keys safely' and a tiny bash helper that stages new token then swaps env and restarts sidecar.
Carlos Mendes: action items: Ben -> CLI precedence + --show-cred-source; Yvonne -> JS/Python SDK: no-retry on 401, TokenScopeError, opt-in telemetry token.scope_mismatch; Asha -> sample-app README + swap script; I'll add unit tests for precedence and integration test for rotation across process restart.
devex-bot: Created task DEVEX-2455 'Credential precedence + rotation detection + SDK no-retry on 401' and added to sprint.
Yvonne Park: small note: prefer not to add more env names. keep REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY canonical and maintain REDWOOD_API_KEY as alias only.
Asha Kapoor: thanks team, will follow up with draft doc and sample script.
Ben Wu: will open the CLI PR later today and link tests.
Carlos Mendes: good. aim for patch release next week.
Asha Kapoor: thanks all :thumbsup:
